description: This file is a TypeScript source code for importing CSV data into a board-based application, converting CSV rows into board and card objects, and exporting an archive.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: Represents a board object with properties like title and card properties.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Base class for different block types such as cards and views.

methods.name: getCsvFilePath
methods.description: Finds the CSV file in the specified folder.

methods.name: getMarkdown
methods.description: Retrieves markdown content for a given card title from markdown folder.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Extracts column headers from CSV input data.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts CSV input data into board and block objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the import process.
